physical_domain.pressure_roundoff_policy: Monotonic pressure permits 64*float64 epsilon*max(abs(P_left),abs(P_right),float64 tiny); physical sound-speed tolerance is unchanged.
physical_domain.coarse_sampling_policy: Split connected interpolation ranges; retain endpoint values and secant diagnostics. Coarse spacing alone supplies no physical exclusion.
physical_domain.chemical_monotonicity_scope: Baryon chemical-potential decrease is recorded independently. On charged or composition-changing paths its relation to compressibility requires the appropriate constrained chemical potential.
physical_domain.attribution: SOURCE_TABLE_DIAGNOSTIC; intrinsic model versus numerical or convention error requires independent reproduction
physical_domain.continuous_domain_status: UNRESOLVED; secants describe adjacent sampled rows and do not certify an interpolant
physical_domain.decision: Retain every source row and investigate supported segments before model-level exclusion

export.free_cluster_decomposition: NOT_AVAILABLE in nonuniform TF; physically computed total composition is in companion composition.json and profiles

global_minimum_status: Finite geometry/seed/radius search only; all attempts and lower unconverged attempts retained.
